StartupSphere is seeking a Node.js Developer to design, develop, test, and deliver software applications for a large user base. The role focuses on software quality, automated testing, release coordination, migration support, and ownership of technical improvements in a remote-first environment.
Computer Software
Responsibilities
Collaborate with quality assurance teams to define test coverage and identify regressions early
Maintain code quality through automated linting, testing, and static analysis
Identify and resolve software defects during staging and testing
Analyze existing technical patterns and recommend cleaner, more maintainable solutions
Coordinate software releases with stakeholders and distributed teams
Develop Terraform integration tests to identify regressions before deployment
Support application and infrastructure migration activities according to project deadlines
Take ownership of technical issues and implement improvements with minimal supervision
Follow established technology best practices and industry standards
Work collaboratively with remote teams to deliver reliable software

A proactive approach to problem-solving and project ownership
